problems.where: design (link key holds mutate:context:issue) / assets/connect.js mint()
problems.problem: The '1-hour access key' is enforced only by connect.js. Anyone holding the opened link key (any script on the project origin, see limites.md) can call context/issue with ttl '0m' (inherits the link's 60 days: got 60.00 d) or '59d' (got 59.00 d), and can delegate mutate:context:issue onward, so stolen children outlive a later page reload; revoking the link does cascade and kill them.
problems.fix: Document it in limites.md next to 'O link aberto é portador'; longer term needs a gateway-side max child ttl per context (PEDIDO-LUIS.md).

problems.problem: After a crash mid-approve the nonce stays in state 'approving' forever and the envelope for the already-issued link is lost; the page must send a new request (expected, but the owner sees no reply). The orphaned link is listed and can be disconnected (N3).

A disconnect that only printed 'manual: ...' exits 0 with ok:false; the SKILL handles it by text ('manual: ...' lines), so this is consistent, but an agent keying on the exit code alone would report success.
